siteTitle: Lives of the Saints for Kids
home.featuredIntro: Every life is told three ways: a short one for little ones, a storybook version for young readers, and the full traditional account for older readers.
home.how1: Open a month and tap a day to see every saint remembered on it.
home.how2: Tap a saint to read their life.
home.how3: Choose the reader's age at the top of each life. We remember your choice.
fast.title: Fasting
fast.note: Fasting guide for families, following common Greek Orthodox practice. Ask your parish priest about your own family's fast.
age.label: Who is reading?
saint.soonTitle: This life is still being written
saint.soonText: Our scribes are busy copying and illustrating the lives of all the saints. This one isn't ready yet — but you can still pray to this saint, and look for them again soon!
saints.title: The Saints
footer.note: Made with love for Orthodox children and their families. Texts are retellings for children; please check the dates with your parish calendar.
